current.text: Charlotte got him from Phoenix with Grayson Allen in the Miles Bridges trade.
He is a bench player in a small role. The projected bench is Allen, Schröder, Steinbach, O'Neale and Grant Williams.
Grayson Allen, not O'Neale, is projected to start while Kon Knueppel is out.
He may get more power forward minutes.
Charlotte has a deep roster and is projected as a play-in team.
Charlotte plans to space the floor and take a lot of threes.
Charlotte has 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum. Its playoff schedule is 4-3-4 games for a March 28 end.

durable.text: He is a corner three shooter and hit corner threes all season long.
He has shown signs of decline. Teams around the league saw him as a negative asset.

note: O'Neale ranks 214 on Yahoo and 157 on ESPN, both sites value him at 0 USD, and he was not drafted in our league last season. Only 144 players get drafted, so leave him on waivers. He is projected for about 8.4 points on 41.8% FG, and his only real help is threes (2.3 per game) with few turnovers. If Charlotte's injuries to Coby White and Kon Knueppel drag on, or he picks up the power forward minutes the notes mention, check early in the season whether he gets near his 28 minutes from last season. Even then he is only a short-term streamer for threes.
